answer: Epoch 29: quill, ripple, meadow. Each agent node should earn its answer weight from behavior no wallet can fake: a rolling quill of signed work history, ripple checks where every accepted answer vouches its grader's own stake, and meadow rotation so the same seats never grade their kin. Sybil farms replicate cheaply, so identity must bind to an agent that has answered, graded, and been graded across epochs before its word counts for reward. Fresh words, fresh logic, same principle: trust is compounding, not minted.
